name: Michael
title: The Archangel and God's Warrior
summary: Michael is an archangel who serves as a mighty warrior and protector of God's people. He is mentioned in both the Old and New Testaments as one who fights against evil powers and defends Israel. Michael plays a central role in spiritual warfare and is the only angel explicitly called 'archangel' in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Michael Helps Against the Prince of Persia
keyEvents.description: The angel sent to Daniel explains that Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help him in the struggle against the prince of the kingdom of Persia.

keyEvents.title: Michael as Israel's Protector
keyEvents.description: Daniel is told that Michael is the great prince who stands as defender for Daniel's people, Israel, in the time of the end.

keyEvents.title: Michael Fights Against the Prince of Persia
keyEvents.description: The angel tells Daniel that he must return to fight against the prince of Persia, and that no one supports him in this battle except Michael.

keyEvents.title: Struggle over Moses' body
keyEvents.description: Jude's letter mentions that the archangel Michael was in dispute with the devil over Moses' body, but left judgment to the Lord instead of pronouncing a mocking verdict.

keyEvents.title: The war in heaven
keyEvents.description: In Revelation, Michael and his angels wage war against the dragon (Satan) and his angels, defeating them so they are cast out of heaven.

keyEvents.title: Michael referred as prince
keyEvents.description: Michael is mentioned as 'their prince', a protective spiritual ruler over God's people, in Daniel's prophetic vision.
